name: syscond-ref
title: Scanner: inline SYSC-REF dropped from SW-SYSCOND
description: A variation-point condition can embed a system constant inline: <SW-SYSCOND>( <SYSC-REF>/.../CANIPCORETYPE_SC</SYSC-REF> ==0)</SW-SYSCOND>. The scanner only captures raw text runs, so the reference vanishes and the editor shows '( ==0)' instead of the legacy '(CANIPCORETYPE_SC==0)'. Capture the inline reference as its path tail, matching the legacy .artext outcome.
creator: deviousprophet
